content: This paper aims to enrich the NSP task to provide more document-level information in the pre-training. Motivated by the in-symmetric property of NSP, we propose to differentiate between different sentence orders by including PSP. Despite the simplicity, extensive experiments demonstrate that the model obtains a better ability in pair-wise semantic reasoning. Our work suggests that the document-level objective is effective, at least for the BERTbase model. In the future, we will investigate the way to take advantages of both large-scale training and our method.
